name: AC Gas Filling & Leak Repair
tagline: Gas Filling & Leak Repair in Chennai
headline: Fix the leak first. Then fill the gas.
summary: Chennai's gas-filling trade runs on repeat business: top up in March, top up again in May. Airam works differently. Every low-gas call starts with a nitrogen pressure test to find the leak. We repair it, pull a vacuum, charge R22, R32, R410A or R290 by weight, and stand behind the work with up to a 90-day warranty.

symptoms.title: Ice on the copper pipes
symptoms.description: Frost on the suction line near the indoor unit is the classic sign of a low refrigerant charge.

symptoms.title: Cooling fades by afternoon
symptoms.description: The AC runs all day but never pulls the room down during Chennai's 40°C peak hours.

symptoms.title: Hissing near the outdoor unit
symptoms.description: A faint hiss at the flare joints or coil means refrigerant is escaping under pressure right now.

symptoms.title: Second top-up this year
symptoms.description: If you paid for gas a few months ago and it is low again, you have a leak, not a gas problem.

symptoms.title: Warm air from the vents
symptoms.description: The compressor runs but the air barely cools, which points to a near-empty circuit.

symptoms.title: Power bills creeping up
symptoms.description: A low charge forces the compressor to run longer for less cooling, and the meter shows it.

faqs.question: Why do you insist on a leak test before filling gas?
faqs.answer: Refrigerant is not fuel; it does not get consumed. A sealed system holds its charge for years, so low gas always means a leak. Topping up without repairing it means the new gas escapes the same way, usually within weeks. Our nitrogen pressure test finds the fault first, so you pay once.

faqs.question: What does AC gas filling cost in Chennai?
faqs.answer: Top-ups start from ₹1,499 and a full R32 charge runs ₹2,500-3,500 depending on tonnage. The nitrogen test and any leak repair are quoted separately, upfront, before work begins. You approve the full figure on-site and the digital invoice matches it to the rupee.

faqs.question: Which refrigerants and brands do you handle?
faqs.answer: We charge R22, R32, R410A and R290 systems, always matched to the nameplate on your unit. That covers Daikin, LG, Voltas, Blue Star, Samsung, Carrier, Hitachi, O General, Mitsubishi Electric and Panasonic. R290 is flammable, so those jobs go only to technicians trained for it.

faqs.question: Why does my AC lose gas every summer?
faqs.answer: In Chennai the usual culprits are corroded copper and badly made flare joints. Sea air near the coast eats pin-holes into coils and pipe bends, and rushed installations leave flare nuts that loosen with vibration. Whatever the cause, the fix is the same: find the exact point, repair it, and retest under pressure before recharging.

faqs.question: Is the gas filling covered by warranty?
faqs.answer: Yes. Leak repairs carry up to a 90-day service warranty, recorded on your digital GST invoice alongside the refrigerant type and grams charged. Because we repair before we refill, the charge actually holds, which is the point.
